resources.title: Skills
resources.description: Agent Skills you can install in your AI assistant, each version security-checked, with versions you can pin.
resources.intro: Give your AI assistant expert skills, from writing code and research to weekly reports. Copy one sentence to install.

steps.title: Use a Skill in three steps
steps.pick: Pick a Skill and press Install
steps.enable: Let your AI assistant install it
steps.ask: Ask for what you need in the chat

resources.found: {count, plural, one {# Skill} other {# Skills}} found for “{q}”
resources.noMatchBody: Try a shorter word, remove a filter, or browse a popular tag.

resources.emptyCategoryBody: Look at the other categories, or check back in a few days.

scan.reviewedNote: {count, plural, one {One more check} other {# more checks}} flagged something to look at; IFAI reviewed this version before publishing it.

pinned.current: This is the fixed link to v{version}, the current version.
pinned.notCurrent: This is v{version}. The current version is v{current}.

resources.withdrawn: v{version} was withdrawn and can no longer be installed.
resources.deprecated: v{version} is deprecated. It still installs, but a newer version is recommended.
resources.delisted: This Skill was taken down and can no longer be installed.

install.title: Install in your AI assistant
install.instruction: Read {url} and follow its steps to install this Skill in {host}.
install.copied: Copied. Paste it to your assistant
install.hint: Paste the instruction into your assistant: it downloads the Zip, checks its fingerprint and puts it in place. Or unzip the Zip into its Skills folder yourself.
install.none: No version of this Skill can be installed right now.
install.withdrawn: This version was withdrawn and cannot be installed.

pending.scanning: v{version} is being checked. v{current} below still installs.
pending.blocked: v{version} did not pass the security check and cannot be installed. v{current} below still installs.

info.title: Information
info.noLicense: None (listed with the author’s written consent)

fingerprint.title: Fingerprint
fingerprint.label: sha256 of the Zip
fingerprint.how: To check a download, run shasum -a 256 {file} (or sha256sum) and compare.

overview.exampleHint: Once it is installed, just say what you want, for example:

overview.skillMd: SKILL.md, as the author wrote it

files.viewerNote: Plain text, exactly as in the package · {size}
files.notShown: This file is not shown here (an image or binary file, or it could not be read just now). Download the Zip to see it.

checks.network: Only talks to the sites it declares

resources.disclaimer: The security check is an automatic static check of this version’s files. It does not mean IFAI vouches for what the Skill does or for its safety.
